added: {{inuse|date=2011-01-21}}[[Image:Unfrosted Pumpkin Cake.jpg|right|250px]]A cake that over-browns can spoil the appearance and taste. Preventing this from happening means averting the possibility up front. Here's how.
[[Category:Cake Making Tips]]
== Steps ==
#  [[Image:Cake Rings.jpg|right|220px]]Check that the [[Fix a Baked Cake Stuck to the Pan|cake pan]] is deep enough for the cake. A shallow pan carries more risk of browning than a deep one.

#  [[Image:Casatiello   Parchment lined cake pan.jpg|right|220px]]Line the sides of the cake pan. Use two layers of brown paper and two layers of [[Use Baking Paper in the Kitchen|baking paper]]. Allow this paper to extend above the pan about 5cm to 7cm. This paper "wall" will help to protect the cake top from browning.

#  [[Image:Smoothing the Batter.jpg|right|220px]]Smooth the cake before adding it to the oven. A flatter surface made by a [[Flip an Egg Without Using a Spatula|spatula]] or knife can help to prevent uneven browning.

#  [[Image:Inside The Oven.jpg|right|220px]]Check the alignment of the oven shelves. The [[Build Simple Floating Shelves|shelf]] used should not place the cook too high to the heat source. Bake the cake in the lower half of the oven.
#  [[Image:The ocean of chocolate!.jpg|right|220px]]Keep an eye on the cake as it bakes. If it appears to be browning unevenly, turn it in quarters several times during [[:Category:Baking|baking]].

#  [[Image:Aluminium foil "booster" bag.jpg|right|220px]]Add a layer of kitchen foil. Halfway through baking, you can place a layer of kitchen foil over the top of the cake to prevent browning, especially where it has a fruit or caramelized top.
== Tips ==
*Keep an eye on the oven temperature. Try lowering it to see if that makes a difference to the cake; this means it'll take a little longer to cook but might solve your over-browning problems.
*Nut toppings an help prevent browning.
== Things You'll Need ==
*Deep pan
*Baking paper and brown paper; scissors
*Oven shelf levels rearranged (where needed)
*Kitchen foil sheet
*Spatula or knife for smoothing cake
